subject: literacy
concept: Showing a character's emotion through actions and dialogue instead of just stating it
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student acts out an emotion through action and speech without naming the emotion aloud, and others guess it
exercise.pictorial: Student matches 'telling' sentences (he was sad) to 'showing' rewrites (he stared at the floor and said nothing)
exercise.abstract: Student rewrites a 'telling' sentence into a 'showing' one using action and dialogue

misconception_flags: adds more description but still directly names the emotion rather than showing it

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
